comparison.objective: Remove spacer dowels and bond laminate onto a drawer front; the candidate sets and locks gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential spacer removal, sheet placement, and adhesive-contact control, not torque counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Laminate must be bonded in the intended alignment without trapped spacers or bad contact; body lacks a full numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Adhesive lamination is a different process and physical skill.
